statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The service was to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The service was to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
